headline: **MLB Daily Roundup: August 1, 2026**
article:
The New York Yankees secured a shutout victory over the Chicago Cubs, with Will Warren pitching 6.2 innings of scoreless baseball. Spencer Jones led the Yankees' offense with a home run and 1 RBI. In other action, the Cincinnati Reds edged out the Pittsburgh Pirates 8-7, while the Philadelphia Phillies fell short in Baltimore. The Toronto Blue Jays took down the St. Louis Cardinals 3-1.

Several key players are dealing with injuries, including Minnesota Twins right-hander Mike Paredes, who has been transferred to the 60-day injured list due to a left oblique strain. Other players on the injured list include Brock Stewart of the Los Angeles Dodgers, Matt Vierling of the Detroit Tigers, J.P. Crawford of the Seattle Mariners, Cionel Pérez of the New York Mets, Shane McClanahan of the Tampa Bay Rays, Gavin Hollowell of the Chicago Cubs, and Cole Sands of the Minnesota Twins.

The Baltimore Orioles made a move on August 1, acquiring outfielder Jhomnardo Reyes from the Minnesota Twins in exchange for right-handed pitcher Dean Kremer. The Minnesota Twins also acquired left-hander A.J. Minter from the New York Mets in a separate trade.

top_news.title: **Yankees Shut Out Cubs 2-0**
top_news.summary: The New York Yankees secured a shutout victory over the Chicago Cubs, with Will Warren pitching 6.2 innings of scoreless baseball, striking out 7 batters and allowing 4 hits. Spencer Jones led the Yankees' offense with a home run and 1 RBI.

top_news.title: **Reds Rally Past Pirates in Thrilling Finish**
top_news.summary: The Cincinnati Reds edged out the Pittsburgh Pirates 8-7 in a closely contested game. Sal Stewart led the Pirates' offense with 2 hits, 1 home run, and 4 RBIs.

top_news.title: **Phillies Fall Short in Baltimore**
top_news.summary: The Philadelphia Phillies dropped a 4-6 decision to the Baltimore Orioles, unable to overcome a strong Orioles offense. Pete Alonso led the Phillies' batting effort with 2 hits, including a home run, and 2 RBIs.

top_news.title: **Cardinals Fall to Blue Jays 3-1**
top_news.summary: The Toronto Blue Jays took down the St. Louis Cardinals 3-1, securing a crucial win. Luis Urías led the Cardinals' offense with a single, 2 RBI, and 1 AB.

top_news.title: **Twins RHP Mike Paredes Shifted to 60-Day IL**
top_news.summary: Minnesota Twins right-hander Mike Paredes has been transferred from the 15-day injured list to the 60-day injured list due to a left oblique strain.

top_news.title: **Orioles Acquire Jhomnardo Reyes in Trade**
top_news.summary: The Baltimore Orioles made a move on August 1, 2026, acquiring outfielder Jhomnardo Reyes from the Minnesota Twins. In exchange, the Orioles traded right-handed pitcher Dean Kremer to the Twins.
